The workflow

From existing finishes to new floors

Review what’s already modeled in one room table, reuse a setup for similar rooms, and apply each room’s design when it’s ready.

  1. 01

    Review

    Search and review room data, current finishes, status, and the proposed finish from one table.

  2. 02

    Design

    Build a single-layer or multi-layer floor finish with independent material and thickness control.

  3. 03

    Preview

    Open a dedicated 3D Section Box preview and optionally colorize the finish for a clearer check.

  4. 04

    Match

    Copy a completed finish setup to other rooms, with options to copy only or copy and apply.

  5. 05

    Apply

    Create finishes for one room or use Apply Selected while each checked room keeps its own configuration.

Capabilities that stay connected

From custom design to final apply.

Set materials and thicknesses per layer, check the design in 3D, then model the finishes for one room or a selection.

Custom Floor Design

Build single-layer and multi-layer finish systems with independent material and thickness control for every layer.

Match & Apply

Copy a room's finish setup to other rooms, then choose whether to copy only or copy and apply.

3D Preview

Review a room in a dedicated Section Box and optionally colorize the finish for clearer visual checking.

Batch Apply

Apply finishes to one room or many selected rooms while each room keeps its own verified configuration.

Central Room Workspace

Work with room number, name, level, area, volume, current finish, proposed finish, status, and searchable data in one table.

Conflict Handling

Automatically resolve safe existing-finish cases while keeping pinned, grouped, structural, or otherwise unsafe floors for manual review.

Configurable Room Table

Add Room parameters as columns, show or hide them, arrange order and widths, search, and use multi-criteria sorting.

Host & Linked Rooms

Use rooms from the host model and, when enabled, loaded linked models with finish ownership and worksharing safety checks.
